AIInterpretationResponse.title: AIInterpretationResponse
AIInterpretationResponse.description: Public schema representing a stored AI recommendation record.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: UPHELD (citizen dispute valid -> reopens case) or OVERTURNED (challenge dismissed -> closes case)

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Mandatory written justification for review decision

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Mandatory justification for contesting official action or resolution

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Mandatory reason for dismissing duplicate candidate

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.default: Model/policy failed to escalate safety-critical grievance

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional notes for linking duplicate incident

OverrideInterpretationRequest.title: OverrideInterpretationRequest
OverrideInterpretationRequest.description: Officer overrides the AI recommendation with custom category/details.

PublicTrackingResponse.title: PublicTrackingResponse
PublicTrackingResponse.description: Publicly safe tracking response containing no private citizen information.

RejectInterpretationRequest.title: RejectInterpretationRequest
RejectInterpretationRequest.description: Officer rejects the AI recommendation entirely.
